title: e2e-audit findings v0.2.0
description: Output contract for e2e-audit. Every finding carries an SHOT+TRACE+ASSERT+SOURCE quad; aggregate (meta) findings are exempt.

id.description: Stable finding id. Format E2E-NNNN. Allocate sequentially per session.

rule.description: Machine-matchable rule slug (kebab-case). Examples: auth-flow-broken, api-500, rbac-bypass, console-error, uncovered-route, coverage-gap-trpc, test-drift, post-run-feedback.

files_affected.description: Source files this finding implicates. sd-fix-style guards MUST prevent edits outside this list unless risk is reclassified.

viewport.description: Optional — only set when a viewport-specific flow reproduced the issue.

test_file.description: Path to the spec that reproduced this (if any).

screenshot_path.description: SHOT — non-empty PNG captured at the assertion moment.

trace_path.description: TRACE — Playwright trace.zip or equivalent recording.

assertion.description: ASSERT — the literal assertion that fired, e.g. `expect(response.status()).toBe(200)` observed 500.

source_file.description: SOURCE — the source file the assertion implicates (router.ts, page.tsx, action.ts, ...).

source_quote.description: Optional verbatim quote from source_file explaining the implicated code.

http.description: Optional — populated for api-contract / server-crash rules.

suggested_fix.description: Advisory only. sd-fix-style agents may consume this.
